verdict.rationale: Datalab documents webhooks that notify an endpoint when a processing job completes, and pipelines that chain processors into reusable configurations. Neither is a user-definable rule system where events automatically trigger actions: webhooks are outbound completion notifications, and pipelines are invoked configurations, not event-driven automations. These are adjacent features, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Webhooks provide real-time notifications when your document processing jobs complete, eliminating the need for continuous polling.
Pipelines chain processors (convert, extract, segment, custom) into reusable, versioned configurations.
